data.body:
AMENDMENT (gap analysis): Add these ACs to address dd-1 verify + dd-2 date-glob + env-override conjunction.

- [ ] DSO_AWS_CMD override referenced in script
  Verify: grep -q 'DSO_AWS_CMD' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh
- [ ] DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD override referenced in script
  Verify: grep -q 'DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh
- [ ] DSO_DUCKDB_CMD override referenced in script
  Verify: grep -q 'DSO_DUCKDB_CMD' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh
- [ ] Test asserts each query subcommand's DuckDB invocation contains a date-glob path fragment (NOT full-bucket scan)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-query-stats.sh 2>&1 | grep -qE '(date.?glob|YYYY-MM-DD|--days)'
- [ ] Roundtrip polls S3 for landing — emits AND verifies (dd-1 second half)
  Verify: grep -qE '(while|for|sleep|poll|retry)' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh && grep -qE '(roundtrip|client_id)' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh
- [ ] DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD invoked by script (not just mentioned in comment)
  Verify: grep -qE '\$DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD|\$\{DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh

Supersedes the single disjunction-style env-override AC. Sentinel client_id=dso-roundtrip-test remains as a strengthened payload-capture assertion enforced by the bash test.
